tasks.title: Desugaring async fn
tasks.statement: Write a function double(x: u32) -> impl Future<Output = u32> without the async keyword in the signature: the body is an async move block returning x * 2.
tasks.hint: async fn f(x) -> T ≈ fn f(x) -> impl Future<Output = T> { async move { … } }.

tasks.title: A future's lifetime
tasks.statement: Write fn longer<'a>(a: &'a str, b: &'a str) -> impl Future<Output = &'a str> + 'a: the async block returns the longer string (by number of characters; on a tie, a).
tasks.hint: The lifetime 'a is part of the future's type.

tasks.title: ? in an async block
tasks.statement:
Run an async block that parses «12» and «30» into numbers with ? and returns their sum. The block's error type must be given: Ok::<i32, std::num::ParseIntError>(…). Print «Ok(42)»; then do the same for «12» and «x» and print «true» (the error flag).

Expected output:
«Ok(42)»
«true»
tasks.hint: Ok::<T, E>(…) tells the compiler the error type.

tasks.title: A reference across .await
tasks.statement: Write async fn sum_with_yield(v: &[i32]) -> i32: sum the elements, calling tokio::task::yield_now().await at each step (the slice reference lives across the .await).
tasks.hint: The slice parameter is a reference; the future lives as long as it is valid.

tasks.title: BoxFuture
tasks.statement: Write fn make(n: u32) -> BoxFuture<'static, u32> (futures::future::BoxFuture): a future that sleeps n ms and returns n·n. Then the driver collects a vector of such futures and runs join_all.
tasks.hint: Box::pin(async move { … }) fits BoxFuture.

tasks.title: Pin::new for Unpin
tasks.statement: Write poll_ready_now<F: Future + Unpin>(f: &mut F) -> Option<F::Output>: one poll with Waker::noop() via Pin::new(f); None on Pending.
tasks.hint: ready() and pending() from futures are Unpin.

tasks.title: pin! and a repeated select!
tasks.statement:
Pin a long future with the tokio::pin! macro (sleeps 100 ms, returns «готово») and in a select! loop wait for either it (&mut fut) or a tick of interval(30 ms). Count the ticks until «готово» arrives. Print «готово» and «тиков>=2: true».

Expected output:
«готово»
«тиков>=2: true»
tasks.hint: &mut fut in select! does not cancel the future on repeated iterations.

tasks.title: Pin<&mut T>
tasks.statement: A struct Counter { n: u32 } (Unpin). Write fn bump(mut p: Pin<&mut Counter>): increment n by 1 via p.as_mut().get_mut().
tasks.hint: get_mut is available only for Unpin types.

tasks.title: poll_fn
tasks.statement: Write fn countdown(mut n: u32) -> impl Future<Output = &'static str> using std::future::poll_fn: while n > 0, decrement, wake_by_ref and Pending; then Ready("пуск"). The driver counts the number of polls.
tasks.hint: poll_fn turns a closure into a Future.

tasks.title: ready and pending
tasks.statement:
Show that tokio::time::timeout(50 ms) over std::future::pending::<u8>() gives Err: print «таймаут»; over std::future::ready(7) it gives Ok(7): print «7».

Expected output:
«таймаут»
«7»
tasks.hint: pending never completes; ready completes immediately.

tasks.title: IntoFuture
tasks.statement: A struct Request { url: String } implements std::future::IntoFuture so that Request::new("x").await returns «ответ от x» (Output = String; IntoFuture = Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = String>>>; inside, a 5 ms sleep).
tasks.hint: await calls into_future for a type that implements IntoFuture.

tasks.title: Async closure
tasks.statement: Write async fn apply_all(items: &[i32], f: impl AsyncFn(i32) -> i32) -> Vec<i32>: apply f to each element sequentially (with .await). The driver passes async closures (Rust ≥ 1.85).
tasks.hint: The bound impl AsyncFn(i32) -> i32; the call is f(x).await.

tasks.title: A closure returning a future
tasks.statement: Write fn make_adder(k: i32) -> impl Fn(i32) -> Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = i32>>>: a closure that for x returns a boxed future of x + k (after yield_now).
tasks.hint: The closure is move, inside it Box::pin(async move { … }).

tasks.title: Data for tasks: Arc
tasks.statement:
Split the vector 1..=1000 into 4 parts (250 each), compute the sum of each in a separate spawn task (data is Arc<Vec<u64>>, the range is a copy of the indices), and add up the results: 500500.

Expected output:
«500500»
tasks.hint: Arc::clone into each task; async move takes the clone.

tasks.title: Fix: 'static in spawn
tasks.statement:
The program does not compile: the spawn task uses a reference to a local variable. Fix it so that it prints «длина 6».

Expected output:
«длина 6»
tasks.hint: Add move and give the string to the task.

tasks.title: Fix: guard across .await
tasks.statement:
The program does not compile: a std::sync::MutexGuard is held across .await, and the future stops being Send. Fix it (release the guard before .await) so that it prints «счётчик 3».

Expected output:
«счётчик 3»
tasks.hint: Put lock() in a separate block { … } before the .await.

tasks.title: Fix: Rc in a task
tasks.statement:
Rc is not Send, so spawn does not accept such a task. Replace Rc with Arc so that it prints «сумма 6».

Expected output:
«сумма 6»
tasks.hint: Arc instead of Rc: the reference count is atomic.

tasks.title: async fn in a trait
tasks.statement: A trait Store { async fn get(&self, k: &str) -> Option<String>; }. Implement it for MemStore(HashMap<String, String>): after yield_now return the value (a clone) or None. The function lookup(s: &impl Store, k: &str) -> String returns the value or «нет».
tasks.hint: async fn in a trait means static dispatch, called through impl Store.

tasks.title: Dynamic asynchronous traits
tasks.statement: A trait Source { fn name(&self) -> String; fn get(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, u32>; } (futures::future::BoxFuture). Implement it for Fast (returns 1 at once) and Slow (sleep 10 ms, then 2). The function total(v: &[Box<dyn Source>]) -> u32 is the sum of get().await.
tasks.hint: BoxFuture<'_, u32> makes dyn Source possible.

tasks.title: Async recursion over a tree
tasks.statement: A tree enum Tree { Leaf(u32), Node(Vec<Tree>) } is declared. Write fn sum(t: &Tree) -> BoxFuture<'_, u32>: a recursive sum of the leaves (yield_now at each node).
tasks.hint: Wrap the recursive call in Box::pin.

tasks.title: Counting cancellations
tasks.statement:
A struct Guard increments a shared counter in Drop if the task did not finish (flag done == false). Run 5 tasks with a 20 ms timeout: three sleep 100 ms, two sleep 5 ms. Print the number of cancelled tasks, «3».

Expected output:
«3»
tasks.hint: Drop runs when a timeout cancels the task.

tasks.title: recv is cancel-safe
tasks.statement:
In a select! over mpsc::Receiver::recv and a timer (a 5 ms sleep in a loop), the sender sends the numbers 1…10 with a 2 ms pause. Make sure all 10 messages are received despite recv being cancelled whenever the timer fires: print the sum, «55».

Expected output:
«55»
tasks.hint: recv is cancel-safe: a message is not lost.

tasks.title: Cleanup on abort
tasks.statement:
A task holds a Guard that prints «очистка» in Drop. Start the task (it sleeps 1 s), call abort() after 20 ms and wait for the result. Expected: «старт», «очистка», «отменена: true».

Expected output:
«старт»
«очистка»
«отменена: true»
tasks.hint: abort destroys the future: Drop runs.

tasks.title: Futures of different types in a loop
tasks.statement:
In a loop create three futures from different async blocks (a number, a string length, a boolean) as Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = String>>> (turn each result into a String), run join_all and print «["42", "3", "true"]».

Expected output:
«["42", "3", "true"]»
tasks.hint: Box::pin turns different async blocks into one type.

tasks.title: A FutureExt chain
tasks.statement:
Using futures::FutureExt, build a chain: ready(3).map(|x| x + 1).then(|x| async move { x * 10 }).boxed(); print the result, 40. Then a lazy future (futures::future::lazy) returns «лениво»: print it.

Expected output:
«40»
«лениво»
tasks.hint: FutureExt: map, then, boxed.

tasks.title: Shared
tasks.statement:
Create a future that increments a global AtomicUsize counter and returns «результат»; turn it into a Shared (FutureExt::shared) and await it with two clones at once via join!. Print both results and the counter: the counter must be 1.

Expected output:
«результат результат»
«1»
tasks.hint: Shared runs the inner future once and hands the result to the clones.

tasks.title: futures::future::select
tasks.statement:
Using futures::future::select (the function, not the macro), find out which of two futures (sleeping 50 and 10 ms) finished first. Print «второй»; then wait for the remaining one too and print «оба готовы».

Expected output:
«второй»
«оба готовы»
tasks.hint: select returns Either and the "remainder", the unfinished future.

tasks.title: try_join_all
tasks.statement:
futures::future::try_join_all: three futures with Result<u32, String>: Ok(1), Ok(2), Ok(3) give «Ok([1, 2, 3])»; then replace the middle one with Err("сбой") and get «Err("сбой")».

Expected output:
«Ok([1, 2, 3])»
«Err("сбой")»
tasks.hint: try_join_all collects the Ok values into a vector or returns the first error.

tasks.title: Bounded concurrency
tasks.statement:
stream::iter(0..8).map(|i| work(i)).buffered(3): work increments an "in progress" counter, sleeps 10 ms, decrements it and records the maximum. Print the results in order, «[0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49]», and «макс одновременных<=3: true».

Expected output:
«[0, 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49]»
«макс одновременных<=3: true»
tasks.hint: buffered(n) keeps the order; buffer_unordered(n) goes by readiness.

tasks.title: Future sizes
tasks.statement: Write sizes() -> (usize, usize, usize): size_of_val of three async blocks: an empty one (async {}), one holding an array [0u8; 512] across an .await, and one like it but keeping the array in a Box (vec![0u8; 512] on the heap). Check: the first < 64, the second ≥ 512, the third < 128.
tasks.hint: A vector keeps its data on the heap; the state machine holds only three words.
